description.zh: ol 关键词：通过 Windows 搜索索引查找经典 Outlook 的邮件和附件（PDF、Word、Excel 的内容），Enter 打开
description.en: ol <words>: finds classic Outlook mail and its PDF, Word and Excel attachments by content through the Windows Search index; Enter opens

description.zh: 搜索主题、正文、发件人和附件内容
description.en: Search subject, body, sender and attachment contents

hint.zh: 关键词，from: to: in: has:att type:pdf date:7d size:>1mb sort:old
hint.en: words, from: to: in: has:att type:pdf date:7d size:>1mb sort:old

title.zh: 在 Outlook 中显示文件夹

ai.description: Search the user's local Outlook mail (classic Outlook, through the Windows Search index) and, when words are given, the text of PDF, Word and Excel attachments. Words match subject, body, sender, attachment names and contents as prefixes; filters: from:name, to:name, in:folder, has:attachment, type:pdf|docx|xlsx (attachments only), "exact phrase", sort:new|old|size|from|subject, date:today|yesterday|week|month|year|<n>d|2026|2026-10|2026-10-21, after:<date>, before:<date>, size:>1mb|<500kb|1mb-100mb. Empty query lists the newest mails. A mail item's title is the subject, its subtitle sender, date and folder; an attachment item's title is the file name, its subtitle sender, date, mail subject and size; preview is the start of the text.

hint.zh: 有关键词时，附件和邮件一起列出
hint.en: Listed beside the mails when you type words

title.zh: 也搜索日历、联系人和任务
title.en: Also search calendar, contacts and tasks

hint.zh: 这些只能用 Shift+Enter 显示文件夹
